verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in Customer.io agent. It builds segments from plain-text descriptions via "Describe segment", analyzes the workspace, runs recurring scheduled tasks such as deliverability reports and segment audits, and accepts work from inside Slack threads. AI-generated styles also appear in the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the in-product agent works as described, and detailed docs on the full scope of tasks it can take on inside the app (e.g. building automations or drafting messages natively rather than via an external AI tool).
